design_parameters.enrich_notes: Stamford follows CT DEEP 2024 Manual; WQV uses P=1.3 in and R=0.05+0.009(I). SHGT separation: 36 in (3 ft) recommended for infiltration bottoms; filtering systems may use 12 in (1 ft) above SHGT per Table 8-5 note. Bioretention trees require min 30 in soil depth. QPA requires ≥18 in depth to SHGT. Infiltration suitability threshold 0.3 in/hr; high-rate soils >8.3 in/hr need pretreatment.
